* POSITION DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE : Relationship Manager-Micro Mortgages
  
  
GRADE : M
  
  
DEPARTMENT : Micro Mortgages
  
  
LOCATION : BRANCH
  
  
SUB-DEPARTMENT : TYPE OF POSITION : Full-time
  
  
REPORTS TO : Cluster Manager-Micro Mortgages
  
  
REPORTING INTO
  
  
Relationship Officer-Micro Mortgages
  
  

* ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE
* Managing End to End sales life cycle of tapping prospects through marketing activities, understanding their requirement and rendering advice
* Negotiating commercials, timely disbursement of loan and providing other Bank Products.
* Implementing tactics to enhance market penetration through Bank branches, Connectors, customer referrals and marketing activities.
* To set up distribution through builder Empanelment (APF),
* Applicable to all loan officers with 12 Months of service
* SIZE OF THE ROLE

FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  
NON-FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  

* Cost of hiring and placing new Relationship Officers at Branches
* Operational Cost of managing the Conveyance and Claims of Relationship Officers
* Cost of procurement marketing collaterals, sales aids
* Shall be expected to manage a portfolio of Rs.15 Cr. Progressively
* Managing a single product across the branches of operations
* Managing a team size of 5 employees progressively
* Managing assets like marketing collaterals, Stationary, Dockets and Systems
* Managing hiring and placement of Relationship Officers in required Branches
* KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

Business/ Financials
  
  

* Aligning with bank Branches & Micro banking team for increasing Traffic for HL
* To set up distribution via connector enrollment and engagement through builder Empanelment (APF).
* Targets on number & value of files for Log-in, approval, disbursement of HL
* 65% of target of HL 15% from FD, 15% of S/A and 10% of standalone Insurance
* Collection of Bounced cases for no zero default track of all customers sourced.
* FTR on all files

Customer (Both Internal & External)
  
  

* Attend and address customer queries and grievances within the defined TAT.
* Managing internal and external customer relationship to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Ensure customers are educated about all products/services offered by Ujjivan.
* Ensure lower customer attrition by providing different products as per customer requirement.
* Focus on lower TAT as per laid down standards.

Internal Process
  
  

* FTR on all work/processes/ files
* Well spread file flow of log-in and disbursal over a month.
* Documentation and preparation of process manuals

Innovation & Learning
  
  

* Mentor loan officer too graduate to next level.
* Work towards grooming self for next level of cluster manager with help of Cluster Manager & Area Manager.
* Completion of goal setting and appraisal on time
* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Educational
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Graduate with 1 -2 Year experience in Ujjivan in Housing Loans
* Post Graduate with 6-12 months experience in Housing loans

Experience(Years and Core Experience Type)
  
  

* 5 years in sales and documentation of loans of which at least 2 years in Housing Loans, home loans or loan against property in an NBFC/ Bank/HFC. Mixed experience of Sales & Credit is acceptable, but should be predominantly in sales

Certifications
  
  

* Relevant certifications shall be an added advantage

Functional Skills
  
  

* Ability to create teams and drive sales performance. Will be required to take complete ownership of Housing business at Cluster level.
* Ability to engage with customers, Plan & execute Marketing and Sales promotion
* Ability to speak and read regional language(s)- is desirable. Ability to communicate in English (Read-speak-write) is required. Has good verbal fluency and uses simple, clear and purposeful language.
* Adequate Computer knowledge

Behavioral Skills
  
  

* Sound Product knowledge
* Should possess Training Skills
* Willingness to travel & relocation as per business requirements and career opportunities
* Managing customer relations
* Performance oriented

Competencies
  
  

* Good Computer Knowledge
* Competent to handle MIS systems and Lending Software
* KEY INTERACTIONS

INTERNAL
  
  
EXTERNAL
  
  

* Product and Marketing Team
* Regional Operations, Credit
* Audit, Vigilance and FCU team
* Area Technical Manager
* Legal Vendors
* External marketing agencies
* Competitor Counterparts

title: Vice President
description:
**Role Overview** 




 You will work closely with senior Client Relationship Management (CRM) colleagues to develop a strong understanding of client strategies, objectives, and service requirements. Your primary focus will be on supporting service delivery, maintaining client satisfaction, and identifying opportunities to enhance the overall client experience.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Relationship Management** 



* Support the management of client relationships through regular interaction and timely responsiveness to client queries.
* Act as a secondary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring solution\-oriented and professional responses.
* Build a strong understanding of client structures, objectives, and service expectations.
* Gather and communicate client feedback to internal teams to support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Product, Compliance, and other teams, to ensure effective service delivery.
* Assist in preparing client meeting materials, agendas, and follow\-up action items.
* Maintain a client\-centric approach and ensure high\-quality communication across all client interactions.



**Service Delivery \& Client Support** 



* Monitor service delivery for assigned clients to ensure agreed service standards are consistently achieved.
* Track and follow up on client requests, issues, and key deliverables.
* Escalate service, operational, or relationship risks to senior CRM team members as appropriate.
* Support the resolution of operational and service\-related issues in a timely manner.
* Apply sound judgment in identifying potential risks and recommending appropriate actions.
* Maintain accurate records of commitments and ensure timely closure of all client\-related actions.



**Commercial Support \& Growth** 



* Identify opportunities to introduce additional services and solutions based on client needs.
* Support senior CRMs in cross\-selling initiatives and client development activities.
* Assist in monitoring service scope and highlighting potential scope changes.
* Support the identification of out\-of\-scope activities and contribute to scope alignment discussions.



**Client Profitability \& Administration** 



* Support the tracking and reporting of client profitability metrics.
* Assist with invoicing coordination and cash collection follow\-ups where required.
* Maintain accurate client records, pipelines, and CRM system updates.



**Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities** 



* Act as a key coordination point between clients and internal teams.
* Support the Lead CRM in managing client relationships and communications.
* Ensure consistent follow\-through on client commitments and deliverables.
* Prepare internal updates, status reports, and management information.
* Contribute to a collaborative and client\-focused team environment.
* Support the implementation of governance practices, including shared mailboxes, structured communication channels, and service delivery models.
* Actively contribute to client experience initiatives by capturing feedback, tracking actions, and supporting service improvement opportunities.



**Skills \& Experience** 



* Approximately 12\+ Years of experience (flexible) in Client Servicing, Relationship Management, or Operations within Fund Services or Financial Services.
* Good understanding of fund structures, client servicing models, and operational processes.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Analytical mindset with sound numerical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Bachelor's degree in finance, Business, or a related discipline. Professional qualifications will be considered an advantage but are not essential.



**Personal Attributes** 



* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships with clients and colleagues.
* Client\-focused mindset with a proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Collaborative team player with a willingness to learn and develop professionally.
* Commercial awareness and an interest in building and strengthening client relationships.
* Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and reliability in delivery.
* Positive attitude with a strong desire for continuous professional growth.



**Career Development** 




 This role is designed as a pathway into a full Client Relationship Manager position, providing exposure to client relationship management, commercial strategy, and senior stakeholder engagement while supporting long\-term career development within the organization.

**Company Description** 
 Capri Global Capital Limited (“Capri Loans”) is a diversified, retail\-focused Non\-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) listed on both the BSE and NSE. The organization manages assets under management (AUM) of over Rs. 40,000 crores and serves more than 7\.6 lakh customers through 1,400\+ branches across India, supported by a workforce of over 13,700 employees as of June 30th, 2026\. Capri Loans offers secured and collateralized lending solutions across Gold Loans, MSME Loans, Construction Finance, and Housing Loans through its wholly owned subsidiary, Capri Global Housing Finance Limited (“CGHFL”). The company also operates fee\-based businesses such as insurance distribution under a corporate agency license and car loan distribution through Capri Loans Car Platform Private Limited (“CLCPPL”). Applicants can expect a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment with exposure to multiple retail lending segments and customer\-focused financial services.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role based in Anand. The Relationship Manager will build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers, understand their financial needs, and recommend suitable loan products across Capri Loans’ portfolio. Responsibilities include managing a customer portfolio, conducting regular follow\-ups, supporting loan applications and documentation, coordinating with internal teams for approvals and disbursements, and ensuring timely collections and account servicing. The role involves achieving assigned sales and quality targets, monitoring customer satisfaction, resolving queries or issues promptly, and adhering to internal policies and regulatory guidelines. The Relationship Manager will also identify new business opportunities in the local market, participate in branch\-level sales initiatives, and contribute to the overall growth and reputation of Capri Loans in the region.

* Strong relationship management, customer service, and client engagement skills, with the ability to build trust and long\-term partnerships.

🌍 WE ARE HIRING \| SR. MANAGER – EXPORTS
 



 Vidya Wires Ltd. \| Anand, Gujarat
 



 Designation: Sr. Manager – Exports
 



 Location: Anand, Gujarat
 



 Department: Export / International Business Division
 



 Reporting To: Managing Director
 



 Experience: 15–20 Years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 


 🚀 About the Role
 
 Vidya Wires Ltd. is looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Sr. Manager – Exports to drive international sales, develop new global markets, acquire international customers, and strengthen relationships with existing customers, distributors, OEMs, and strategic business partners.
 



 The role will also support the international business development initiatives of ALCU Industries Pvt. Ltd.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Export / International Sales and Business Development, preferably from the Winding Wires, Copper \& Aluminium, CTC Conductors, Electrical, Cables, Metals, or Manufacturing industry.
 


 🌎 Key Responsibilities
 
 International Sales \& Business Development
 


* Develop and execute export sales strategies for international markets.
* Achieve annual export sales, revenue, and profitability targets.
* Identify and develop new countries, markets, customers, and business opportunities.
* Build and maintain a strong international B2B customer, distributor, agent, and channel network.
* Develop relationships with OEMs, importers, distributors, EPC companies, and industrial customers.
* Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and feasibility studies.
* Develop market\-entry strategies for new territories.
* Build a strong sales pipeline and ensure consistent business conversion.



 Key Account Management
 


* Manage relationships with key international customers and strategic accounts.
* Understand customer requirements, specifications, forecasts, and future projects.
* Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and contracts.
* Resolve customer complaints and escalations in coordination with internal teams.
* Drive customer retention, repeat business, and account expansion.



 Pricing \& Commercial Management
 


* Develop export pricing based on costs, market conditions, competition, freight, currency movements, and target margins.
* Prepare and negotiate commercial offers and long\-term supply agreements.
* Ensure commercially viable and profitable international business.
* Manage commercial aspects including Incoterms, payment terms, LC requirements, credit terms, freight, insurance, and claims.



 Export Operations \& Compliance
 


* Coordinate with EXIM, Finance, Logistics, Production, Planning, and Quality teams for smooth execution of export orders.
* Ensure timely documentation and shipment execution.
* Maintain knowledge of export documentation, international trade practices, Incoterms, LC terms, and applicable export\-import regulations.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, banks, customs, and other stakeholders.



 International Marketing
 


* Develop international market\-development and marketing initiatives.
* Identify and participate in relevant global exhibitions, trade fairs, conferences, and technical events.
* Support international customer presentations, product demonstrations, technical seminars, and promotional activities.
* Work with the marketing team to strengthen global brand visibility.



 Team \& Business Leadership
 


* Guide and mentor the export sales team.
* Establish KRAs and monitor sales performance.
* Develop regional representatives, agents, distributors, and channel partners.
* Provide international market insights to Production, NPD, Quality, and Management teams.

 Experience in one or more of the following industries will be preferred:
 


* Copper \& Aluminium Winding Wires
* Winding Wires
* CTC Conductors
* Electrical Conductors
* Electrical Cables
* Power \& Electrical Products
* Copper / Aluminium Products
* Metals
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Manufacturing

 * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Management / Marketing or related discipline.
* MBA in International Business / Marketing will be preferred.
* 15–20 years of relevant experience in Export Sales, International Sales, or International Business Development.
* Proven experience in developing international markets and acquiring global B2B customers.
* Experience managing OEMs, distributors, agents, and key international accounts.
* Strong understanding of export documentation, international commercial terms, and logistics.


 💡 Key Skills
 * International sales \& business development
* Global B2B customer management
* Market development and customer acquisition
* Commercial negotiation and contract management
* Export documentation and compliance
* Incoterms \& LC knowledge
* Distributor/channel development
* Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Cross\-cultural business communication
* Strong execution and follow\-up capabilities
* Willingness to travel internationally


 📊 Key KPIs
 * Achievement of export sales targets
* International revenue and profitability growth
* New customer acquisition
* New market / country development
* Existing customer growth and retention
* Distributor and channel development

 ✈️ International Travel
 
 The role will involve international travel for customer meetings, distributor/OEM meetings, exhibitions, trade fairs, technical seminars, negotiations, market development, and key\-account reviews.

title: CSM
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vidya Wires is one of India’s largest manufacturers and exporters of enameled copper wire, with over 40 years of industry experience. Based in Gujarat, the company produces a wide range of copper products, including wires, wire strips, paper\-covered strips and wires, and copper tapes. Vidya Wires focuses on building long\-term relationships by consistently delivering superior quality products and welcoming client feedback to drive continuous improvement. The company operates with strong ethical standards, earning a trusted reputation in the copper wire sector. Its strength lies in a skilled and experienced workforce committed to meeting challenges while ensuring quality and timely delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Customer Success Manager (CSM) role based in Nadiad. The CSM will manage and nurture client relationships, ensuring that customers receive high\-quality service and support throughout their engagement with Vidya Wires. Daily responsibilities include understanding client requirements, coordinating with production and logistics teams, monitoring order status, and proactively addressing issues related to quality, delivery, and documentation. The role involves conducting regular check\-ins with clients, gathering feedback, and translating it into actionable improvements for internal teams. The CSM will also prepare reports, maintain accurate records, support onboarding of new clients, and contribute to process optimization that enhances customer satisfaction and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship and account management skills, including the ability to build trust, handle client queries, and manage expectations.
* Communication and interpersonal skills for clear verbal and written interactions with clients and internal teams.
* Organizational and time\-management skills to oversee multiple accounts, follow up on deliveries, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills to understand client issues, identify root causes, and collaborate on effective solutions.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing operations and supply chain processes; experience in industrial or B2B environments is an advantage.
* Proficiency in common office software (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing, email) and ability to work with CRM or ERP tools.
* Relevant educational background in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience in customer success or sales support will also be considered.
* Ability to work on\-site in Nadiad, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and maintain a client\-focused, ethical approach.
